def check_constraints():
    from z3 import Solver, Int, Implies, sat

    # Variable declarations (merged from base script and constraint sets)
    frame_flags = Int('frame_flags')
    DWARF_FRAME_CFA_REG_OFFSET = Int('DWARF_FRAME_CFA_REG_OFFSET')
    prev = Int('prev')
    reg = Int('reg')
    reg_flags = Int('reg_flags')
    DWARF_REG_OFFSET = Int('DWARF_REG_OFFSET')

    s = Solver()

    # --- Base script constraints ---
    s.add(Implies(frame_flags == DWARF_FRAME_CFA_REG_OFFSET, prev != 0))
    s.add(reg == 0)

    # --- Constraint set 1 ---
    s.add(reg == 0)
    s.add(prev != 0)
    s.add(frame_flags == DWARF_FRAME_CFA_REG_OFFSET)

    # --- Constraint set 2 ---
    s.add(reg_flags == DWARF_REG_OFFSET)
    s.add(reg != 0)

    return s.check() == sat
